name: Canada
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: snow blower
inventions.description: A snow blower or snowblower or snow thrower is a machine for removing snow from an area where it is problematic, such as a driveway, sidewalk, roadway, railroad track, ice rink, or runway.

inventions.name: Manic GT
inventions.description: The Manic GT is a sports car that was built in the province of Québec in Canada from 1969 to 1971.

inventions.name: Canadian pipe mine
inventions.description: The Canadian pipe mine, also known as the McNaughton tube, was a type of landmine deployed in Britain during the invasion crisis of 1940–1941.

inventions.name: Amauti
inventions.description: The amauti is the parka worn by Inuit women of the eastern area of Northern Canada.

inventions.name: Snowshoe
inventions.description: Snowshoes are specialized outdoor gear for walking over snow.

inventions.name: Ebola vaccine
inventions.description: An Ebola vaccine is a vaccine used to prevent Ebola virus disease (Ebola).

inventions.name: Contrabass bugle
inventions.description: The contrabass bugle is the lowest-pitched brass instrument in the drum and bugle corps and marching band hornline.

inventions.name: Professional video camera
inventions.description: A professional video camera is a high-end device for creating electronic moving images.

inventions.name: Compound steam engine
inventions.description: A compound steam engine unit is a type of steam engine where steam is expanded in two or more stages.

inventions.name: Hydrofoil
inventions.description: A hydrofoil is a lifting surface, or foil, that operates in water.

inventions.name: Uno (dicycle)
inventions.description: The Uno is a novel self-balancing electric motorcycle using two wheels side by side.
